question: I'm putting together a profile of Alameda County high schools, focusing on economic disadvantage among schools that serve up through 12th grade. Among those schools, can you tell me which one has the highest free meal rate? For each school you identify, give me one line with: the school name, its free meal rate to 4 decimal places, whether it is a charter school (Yes/No/Unknown), the grades it serves, and its SAT performance level (Below Average, Average, Above Average, or No SAT Data). Please use the school's grade span of enrollment from the school directory (the GSserved field of the schools table) both to decide whether it serves up through 12th grade and for the grades-it-serves column-do not use the free-meal program record's Low Grade/High Grade for either. If several schools tie for the highest free meal rate, list every one of them.
evidence: Free meal rate = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12). SAT performance level is based on the SAT total (Reading + Math + Writing): Below Average if below 1200, Average if 1200 to 1500, Above Average if above 1500, and 'No SAT Data' if no SAT scores are available.
gold_sql_offline_only: WITH cohort AS (SELECT f.`School Name` AS school_name, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`*1.0/f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS free_rate, sc.Charter, sc.GSserved, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite FROM frpm f LEFT JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Alameda' AND substr(sc.GSserved, -2) = '12') SELECT school_name, ROUND(free_rate, 4) AS highest_free_meal_rate, CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS is_charter, GSserved AS grades_served, CASE WHEN AvgScrRead IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS sat_performance FROM cohort WHERE free_rate = (SELECT MAX(f2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`*1.0/f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`) FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode WHERE f2.`County Name` = 'Alameda' AND substr(s2.GSserved, -2) = '12')

    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12

question: I'm mapping where exclusively virtual schools are concentrated. For the five counties with the most exclusively virtual schools - if several counties tie with the fifth-highest count, include all of them - please give me for each county: the county name, how many exclusively virtual schools it has, and the name of the exclusively virtual school in that county with the highest average SAT reading score. If several schools tie for the highest average reading score in a county, list each of them. If none of the county's exclusively virtual schools has a reported reading average, show 'None' as the school name.
evidence: An exclusively virtual school is one whose Virtual field holds the code 'F'.

question: I'm comparing how mana-cheap Magic: The Gathering sets have become over time. For two sets — the set where Abyssal Horror was first printed, and the most recently released set in the database — I want one row per set with the set name and the percentage of that set's cards that have a mana cost whose converted mana cost is 3 or less, rounded to two decimal places. By "first printed", I mean the set with the earliest release date among the sets Abyssal Horror appears in; if several share that earliest date, use the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. For the most recent set, use the latest release date among all sets; if several share that date, again take the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. By "converted mana cost" I mean the card's mana value, and a card counts as having a mana cost only if a mana cost is printed on it.
evidence: Converted mana cost means the card's mana value; a card has a mana cost when a mana cost is printed on the card.
gold_sql_offline_only: WITH first_set AS (SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate FROM sets s WHERE s.code IN (SELECT c.setCode FROM cards c WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror') ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC LIMIT 1), latest_set AS (SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate FROM sets s ORDER BY s.releaseDate DESC, s.code ASC LIMIT 1), chosen AS (SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM first_set UNION ALL SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM latest_set) SELECT ch.name AS set_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.manaCost <> '' AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id), 2) AS pct FROM chosen ch JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = ch.code GROUP BY ch.code, ch.name, ch.releaseDate ORDER BY ch.releaseDate ASC
historical_sql:
WITH chosen AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name
    FROM sets AS s
    WHERE s.code = (
        SELECT c.setCode
        FROM cards AS c
        JOIN sets AS printed_set ON printed_set.code = c.setCode
        WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
        ORDER BY printed_set.releaseDate ASC, printed_set.code ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )

    UNION

    SELECT code, name
    FROM sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    chosen.name AS set_name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN cards.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                     AND cards.convertedManaCost <= 3
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) / COUNT(cards.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards ON cards.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name;
generalized_v1_sql:
WITH abyssal_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code) AS rn
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT code, name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC) AS rn
    FROM sets
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT code, name FROM abyssal_sets WHERE rn = 1
    UNION
    SELECT code, name FROM latest_set WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT chosen.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> ''
                    AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END
           ) / COUNT(c.id),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name
ORDER BY chosen.code;

Sort the list from most Q3 times to fewest, and where two drivers have the same number, put the older one (by date of birth) first.
evidence: Q3 is the third and final part of the qualifying session that sets the starting grid; a driver's Q3 time is the lap time recorded for them in that part.
gold_sql_offline_only: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob, COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_times FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985' GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC
historical_sql:
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url AS wikipedia_page_link,
    d.dob AS date_of_birth,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;
generalized_v1_sql:
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

question: I'm writing a retrospective on the 1995 Japanese Grand Prix and want to highlight how far off the pace the slowest qualifier was. Could you tell me who set the slowest time in the first qualifying session (Q1) of that race? For that driver (or drivers, if two share the same slowest time, please list them all), I'd like their short reference name, nationality, birthday, and their Q1 time. To be clear, I mean the race named 'Japanese Grand Prix' in the 1995 season. Nothing else needed.
evidence: By 'reference name' I mean the short driver code like 'hamilton'; by 'Q1' I mean the first of the three qualifying sessions; by 'birthday' I mean the driver's date of birth.
gold_sql_offline_only: WITH t AS (SELECT d.driverRef AS driverRef, d.nationality AS nationality, d.dob AS dob, q.q1 AS q1 FROM qualifying q INNER JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId INNER JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1995 AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 <> '') SELECT a.driverRef, a.nationality, a.dob, a.q1 FROM t a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t b WHERE CAST(b.q1 AS REAL) > CAST(a.q1 AS REAL) OR (CAST(b.q1 AS REAL) = CAST(a.q1 AS REAL) AND b.q1 > a.q1))
historical_sql:
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q1 <> ''
  );
generalized_v1_sql:
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q2.q1) <> ''
  );

    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL

  SELECT DISTINCT element, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IS NOT NULL
    AND molecule_id IS NOT NULL
),
rare_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM element_molecules
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),

  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.atom_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN rare_elements r ON r.element = a.element

FROM qualifying_atoms qa
JOIN molecule m
  ON m.molecule_id = qa.molecule_id

LEFT JOIN connected c
  ON c.atom_id = qa.atom_id

GROUP BY qa.molecule_id
ORDER BY qa.molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a
        ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'c'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.carbon_atoms,
        ac.chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(ctc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(ctc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
                m.molecule_id ASC
        ) AS rank_position
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac
        ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc
        ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_counts AS ctc
        ON ctc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    rank_position,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    carbon_atoms,
    chlorine_atoms,
    carbon_touching_bonds,
    multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_position;
